TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.ACCESSIBLE_VI: Accessible via on‑demand query adapters (Spark / DuckDB / Azure Data Lake query).
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.AFTER_12_MONT: After 12 months, segments transition to Archive tier.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.AFTER_EXPIRY_: After expiry, the rehydrated dataset is purged.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.ARCHIVE_SPANS: Archive spans (~1–3 years) are stored as deep‑compressed Parquet (larger row groups, higher compression) in a lower‑cost storage tier.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.AUTOMATIC_ROL: Automatic roll‑off begins after day 60 (older documents gradually marked for cold export).
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.AVOID_REGEX_O: Avoid regex on high‑cardinality fields; index service, traceId, spanId, status.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.A_BACKGROUND_: A background process batches older hot traces and stages them for cold export (Parquet). During staging you still see them as normal until the export job confirms completion.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.COLD_TRACES_A: Cold traces (approx. 4–12 months old) live in Azure Blob Storage as partitioned Parquet files.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.COMPACTION_GR: Compaction groups small hourly files into daily sets for faster scans.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.COMPRESSION_S: Compression: Snappy (Parquet) in Azure Blob Storage.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.CONTACT_YOUR_: Contact your platform administrator to begin this process.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.EXPECT_HIGHER: Expect higher latency (seconds) for large scans.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.FILES_SEALED_: Files sealed after 24h ingestion window completes.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.FILTERS_PUSH_: Filters push down on partition columns (year, month, day, service) for efficiency.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.HOT_TRACES_AR: Hot traces are stored in MongoDB Time Series collections for low‑latency, ad‑hoc querying.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.INTENDED_FOR_: Intended for audits, incident forensics, legal hold.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.NOT_DIRECTLY_: Not directly queryable from the UI.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.ON_APPROVAL_D: On approval, data is temporarily rehydrated to a secure cold workspace (time‑boxed).
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.OPEN_AN_ADMIN: Open an admin request ticket specifying: time range, services, trace filters.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.OPTIMIZED_FOR: Optimized for cost & analytical scans, not millisecond lookups.
Optimized for write throughput + real‑time dashboards.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.RETENTION_TAR: Retention target: first 60 days are fully indexed; total hot window 90–120 days.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.SCHEMA_EVOLUT: Schema evolution handled via additive columns; breaking changes versioned.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.USE_TIME_RANG: Use time range filters to leverage time‑series bucketing efficiently.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.YOU_CAN_BROWS: You can browse & filter these traces directly in the list view. No admin action required.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.YOU_CAN_RUN_B: You can run batch queries from the UI by choosing a date range outside the hot window.
TRACE_GUIDELINE_STEPS_DOCS.YOU_RECEIVE_A: You receive a signed URL or a temporary query workspace link.
